independent_hard_negative.name: malformed_decoded_physical_state_incompatible_dynamic_type
independent_hard_negative.construction: The final restart record preserved schema, column, parameter, template, layout, lineage, revision and committed-time metadata, but its decoded polymorphic physical_state was replaced by a different concrete transaction_state_t subtype.
independent_hard_negative.required_behavior: Reject before authoritative registry publication and leave every fresh target state uninitialized.

atomicity_control.observation: Late-record reconstruction rejection left the complete fresh target registry uninitialized.

source_interpretation.trusted_reconstruction_validation: validates provenance, allocation, time and cloneability, but does not bind the decoded concrete physical-state dynamic type to the declared template/backend/layout identity
source_interpretation.publication_effect: Once every opaque reconstruction returns success, candidate_states is assigned wholesale to state_registry, so the incompatible dynamic type becomes authoritative committed state.

not_executed_after_hard_negative: remaining negative matrix items already covered by owner evidence
not_executed_reason: The qualification matrix froze any hard-negative fail-open as sufficient for NOT_QUALIFIED. Continuing the mechanical matrix cannot reverse this admission failure.

route_back.required_remediation: Bind decoded physical continuation state to an explicit qualified physical-state identity/schema associated with the declared template/backend/layout, and reject incompatible decoded state before any registry publication.
route_back.requalification_rule: Independent F-MQ must qualify a new exact immutable candidate after owner remediation; F-MQ25 must not patch production source.
